components.name: WordPress Core
components.decision: Use the official WordPress distribution through WordPress Studio.

components.name: WordPress Studio
components.decision: Primary local development environment on Windows; not production hosting.

components.name: Web Studio Core
components.decision: Own plugin for minimal client role and portal. Does not replace WordPress authentication.

components.name: Wordfence Security
components.freeTier: Free plugin with optional paid upgrades; verify exact free features during installation.
components.decision: Evaluate as the single security plugin for firewall, login protection and administrator 2FA. Do not add a second plugin for the same functions without a documented need.

components.name: UpdraftPlus
components.freeTier: Verify backup destinations, restore workflow and any size/feature limits.
components.decision: Evaluate for scheduled backups and tested restore.

components.name: The SEO Framework
components.freeTier: Verify current free functionality and compatibility.
components.decision: Preferred lightweight SEO candidate; compare before selecting.

components.name: Forminator
components.freeTier: Verify current form, anti-spam, export and notification limits.
components.decision: Evaluate for contact and request forms; choose only one forms plugin.

components.name: FluentSMTP
components.freeTier: Plugin is not an email provider; SMTP/API credentials and provider terms are separate.
components.decision: Evaluate for reliable transactional email delivery. Never commit credentials.

components.name: Polylang
components.freeTier: Verify free language and translation workflow limits.
components.decision: Install only if the demo requires multiple languages.

components.name: WooCommerce
components.freeTier: Core plugin is free; payment gateways, extensions and payment processing may have separate costs.
components.decision: Do not install in the base build unless the demo site needs a store.

components.name: LiteSpeed Cache
components.freeTier: Plugin includes features that depend on LiteSpeed server infrastructure; verify hosting compatibility.
components.decision: Do not install until production hosting is selected; avoid overlapping cache/optimization plugins.
